author: buntine (repository author)
usage: High-frequency mechanical texture residual mixed with per-car combustion synthesis. This shared sample is not an authenticated recording of any of the six featured models.
processing: Mono 22050 Hz; high-pass residual, boundary crossfade, DC removal and Uint8 PCM normalization; embedded in engine-texture.js.
rejected_sources: Unclear-licence VDrift and unlicensed sound-library repos were inspected but not downloaded or used.
